summary: Comprehensive testing of Stripe payment integration completed. All backend APIs (packages, checkout, status, transactions) pass 21/21 tests. Frontend pages (Plans, Checkout, Transactions) all load correctly and integrate properly with backend APIs. Stripe checkout flow works end-to-end - clicking upgrade redirects to actual Stripe checkout page.
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/payments/packages - Returns 200 with 5 packages (free, pro_monthly, pro_annual, enterprise_monthly, enterprise_annual)
Backend: POST /api/payments/checkout - Free plan returns requires_payment=false
Backend: POST /api/payments/checkout - Paid plans return Stripe checkout URL and session_id
Backend: POST /api/payments/checkout - Creates transaction record in database before redirect
Backend: POST /api/payments/checkout - Invalid package returns 400 error
Backend: GET /api/payments/status/{session_id} - Returns payment status from Stripe
Backend: GET /api/payments/transactions - Returns user transactions filtered by user_id or email
Backend: GET /api/payments/transactions/all - Returns all transactions with pagination (admin)
Frontend: /user/plans - Plans page loads with data-testid='user-plans-page'
Frontend: /user/plans - Shows Free ($0), Pro ($29), Enterprise ($99) plan cards
Frontend: /user/plans - Monthly/Annual toggle works with 'Save 17%' badge
Frontend: /user/plans - Current plan usage stats displayed (Meetings, Storage, Transcriptions)
Frontend: /user/plans - Upgrade button on Pro plan initiates Stripe checkout
Frontend: Clicking Pro Upgrade redirects to checkout.stripe.com with correct $29 amount
Frontend: /user/transactions - Transaction History page loads with data-testid='user-transactions-page'
Frontend: /user/transactions - Shows stats cards (Total Spent, This Month, Transactions count)
Frontend: /user/transactions - Export All button visible with data-testid='export-btn'
Frontend: /admin/transactions - Admin transactions page loads with data-testid='admin-transactions-page'
Frontend: /admin/transactions - Shows all 13 test transactions with user info, amounts, packages, statuses
Frontend: /admin/transactions - Stats show Total Revenue, Pending ($1022.00), Refunded, Failed count
Frontend: /admin/transactions - Refresh and Export Report buttons work
Frontend: /user/checkout?status=cancelled - Shows 'Payment Cancelled' state with data-testid='cancelled-state'
Frontend: /user/checkout - Shows 'No charges have been made' message
critical_code_review_comments: Stripe integration using emergentintegrations library is working correctly with real API calls
Transaction records are properly created BEFORE redirecting to Stripe checkout
Payment status polling on checkout page implements proper timeout and retry logic
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
Frontend correctly uses VITE_API_URL environment variable for API calls

test_credentials.user_signup: Create new account via /signup page with any email format

seed_data_creation: 13 test payment transactions created during testing with various packages (Pro Monthly, Pro Annual, Enterprise Monthly)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe payment integration is fully functional. Backend endpoints: /api/payments/packages, /api/payments/checkout, /api/payments/status/{session_id}, /api/payments/transactions, /api/payments/transactions/all all working. Frontend pages /user/plans, /user/checkout, /user/transactions, /admin/transactions all integrate correctly with backend. Clicking upgrade redirects to actual Stripe checkout page at checkout.stripe.com. Test payment flow: signup -> /user/plans -> click Upgrade on Pro -> redirects to Stripe checkout.
stripe_integration_notes: Uses emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout. Real Stripe checkout sessions are created in Sandbox mode. Transaction records are persisted to MongoDB before Stripe redirect. Payment status is polled from Stripe API on checkout return.
